verifiedScope: Daynori Web Core (Notes, Tasks, Routines, Search, Sync)

targetInfrastructure.computeTier: Render Free (0.1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, shared IP)

scenarios.verdict: DEMONSTRABLY SUPPORTED on Render Free + Supabase Free ($0/mo). Zero 5xx errors, low latency, connection pool within safe operating bounds.

BREAKING POINT: Free tier direct pooler (15 conns) and single-process rate limiter (60 req/min) saturate under 150 CCU. Managed PaaS with PgBouncer connection pooling and multi-instance compute strictly required.
scenarios.hostingRecommendation: Managed PaaS Option 1: 2x Render Standard + Supabase Pro (PgBouncer) + Upstash Redis ($80–$110/mo)

scenarios.verdict: HARD COLLAPSE on Free Tier: 300 simultaneous sockets exhaust 0.1 vCPU event loop, trigger widespread 429 rate limits, and spike queue times. Managed PaaS with auto-scaling, transaction pooling, and edge caching is non-negotiable.
scenarios.hostingRecommendation: Managed PaaS Option 1 Scaled: 2–4x Render Standard + Supabase Pro + Compute Add-on + Cloudflare Pro ($110–$160/mo)

scalingTriggers.provisionSupabasePro: Trigger when registered users exceed 1,000 or peak CCU exceeds 30 (enables PgBouncer 200+ pooled connections).
scalingTriggers.provisionRenderPaidInstance: Trigger when API p95 latency exceeds 500ms or CPU reaches 70% sustained.
scalingTriggers.provisionRedisRateLimiter: Trigger when deploying multi-instance horizontal compute.

rollbackTriggers: Sustained 5xx error rate > 5% over 5 consecutive minutes.
API p95 latency > 3000ms over 5 consecutive minutes.
Database connection pool exhaustion > 90% sustained for > 2 minutes.
